title: Drawing the lot
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Rain. Wood stays in the Datsun in Lot C and draws the lot for the whole hour. The guard walks by twice and doesn't tap. The drawing is the best thing he's made this month and it's a parking lot.

panels.composition: Lot C in rain, from inside the Datsun: the wipers stopped, the windshield running, the lot's lines, the spruce.

image.prompt: a rainy community college parking lot seen through a car windshield running with water, painted lines and spruce trees beyond, black and white, no words

panels.composition: WOOD drawing on the wheel. The GUARD walking past the hood with a hood up. Not tapping.

image.prompt: a young man drawing on a pad against a steering wheel while a security guard in a rain hood walks past the car without stopping, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pad: the lot, every line, every puddle, the guard's back, in a line that has stopped being nervous.

image.prompt: a drawing pad showing a rain-soaked parking lot rendered in confident ink lines with a guard's back in it, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The guard passing again the other way. A glance at the pad through the glass. A nod. Wood nodding back. Nobody says student.

image.prompt: a security guard glancing through a rainy car window at a drawing pad and giving a small nod, the young man inside nodding back, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The best drawing of the month is a parking lot. The guard doesn't tap.
